qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Entrenched niche brand leadership across consumer staple categories (Arm & Hammer, Trojan, First Response, Batiste, Waterpik, TheraBreath) where #1/#2 market shares and retail shelf space deter direct competition from conglomerates. Demonstrated pricing power through raw material inflation cycles with gross margins sustained around 44-45% and 10-year median ROIC ~16.8% (FY24-FY25 GAAP ROIC ~13.5-14.0%). Key erosion risks include private-label penetration in value laundry and retail customer concentration.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Resilient consumer staples portfolio of focused #1/#2 brands anchored by Arm & Hammer. Pricing power demonstrated across inflationary cycles with gross margins at 44-45%. Structurally insulated across all 5 macrotrends with FCF conversion >100% and conservative ~2.7x net debt to net income. [5-10Y g: volume 1.5% + price 1.5% + mix/reinvestment 2.0% - margin drags 0.0% + buybacks 1.5%]
qualitative.evidence: 10-year median ROIC of 16.8% (FY24 ~14.0%, FY25 ~13.8%). FY25 net sales reached $6.20B with operating income of $1.17B (18.9% margin) and FCF of ~$1.1B on net income of $741.5M (>140% FCF conversion). Net debt of ~$2.0B easily serviceable via ~2.7 years of net income with interest coverage at ~12.3x.
